name: Trig Applications
roadmap: Apply your knowledge of triangles to solve complex real-world problems. Master the Sine and Cosine rules, calculate areas of triangles using trigonometry, navigate with 2D Bearings, and solve problems involving heights and distances using Angles of Elevation and Depression.
roadmap_zh: 應用三角形知識來解決複雜的現實問題。掌握正弦和餘弦公式，利用三角學計算三角形面積，使用二維方位進行導航，並利用仰角和俯角解決涉及高度和距離的問題。

learning_modules.title: Sine Rule & Area of Triangle
learning_modules.title_zh: 正弦公式與三角形面積

concepts.name: Sine Rule Applications
concepts.key_takeaway: The Sine Rule is essential when dealing with 'opposite pairs'. Use it when you have a side and its opposite angle. In applications, it often helps find distances between points not directly reachable.
concepts.key_takeaway_zh: 當處理「對應組」時，正弦公式是必不可少的。當你有一條邊及其對角時使用它。在應用中，它通常有助於找出無法直接到達的點之間的距離。

concepts.name: Trigonometric Area Formula
concepts.key_takeaway: This formula allows you to find the area of ANY triangle as long as you have two sides and the included angle (SAS). No height required!
concepts.key_takeaway_zh: 公式讓你可以求出任何三角形的面積，只要你有兩條邊及其夾角 (SAS)。不需要高度！

tips: Remember the unit: Area is always in square units (e.g., $cm^2$).
If only two angles are given, use the fact that angles in a triangle sum to $180^\circ$ to find the third angle.
tips_zh: 記住單位：面積總是平方單位（例如 $cm^2$）。
如果只給出兩個角，利用三角形內角和為 $180^\circ$ 的性質求出第三個角。

common_traps.trap_zh: 面積公式中的角度錯誤
common_traps.description: Using an angle that is not 'included' between the two sides you chose.
common_traps.description_zh: 使用了並非你所選兩條邊「夾」著的角度。
common_traps.fix: Ensure the angle $C$ is exactly the one formed where sides $a$ and $b$ meet.
common_traps.fix_zh: 確保角度 $C$ 正好是邊 $a$ 和邊 $b$ 相交所形成的角度。

learning_modules.title: Cosine Rule Applications

concepts.name: Cosine Rule for Distances
concepts.key_takeaway: The Cosine Rule is your 'extension' of Pythagoras. Use it when you have two sides and the included angle (SAS) to find the distance between the two endpoints.
concepts.key_takeaway_zh: 餘弦公式是畢氏定理的「擴展」。當你已知兩條邊及其夾角 (SAS) 時，使用它來求兩個端點之間的距離。

tips: For 'standard' type questions, you might need to find an angle using the rearranged Cosine Rule: $\cos A = \frac{b^2 + c^2 - a^2}{2bc}$.
Always check if the triangle should be right-angled first (Pythagoras), which is a simpler case of the Cosine Rule where $\cos 90^\circ = 0$.
tips_zh: 對於「標準」型題目，你可能需要使用變形後的餘弦公式求角：$\cos A = \frac{b^2 + c^2 - a^2}{2bc}$。
總是先檢查三角形是否為直角三角形（畢氏定理），那是餘弦公式在 $\cos 90^\circ = 0$ 時的一個較簡單情況。

common_traps.description: Calculating $b^2 + c^2$ and then subtracting $2bc$ before multiplying by $\cos A$.
common_traps.description_zh: 計算了 $b^2 + c^2$ 後，在乘以 $\cos A$ 之前先減去了 $2bc$。
common_traps.fix: Follow PEMDAS: multiply $2bc \cos A$ first, then subtract the result from $b^2 + c^2$.
common_traps.fix_zh: 遵循運算順序：先計算 $2bc \cos A$ 的乘積，然後再從 $b^2 + c^2$ 中減去。建議：$a^2 = (b^2 + c^2) - (2bc \cos A)$。

learning_modules.title: 2D Bearings & Navigation

concepts.name: Navigation involving Bearings
concepts.key_takeaway: In HKDSE, bearings are always 3-digit and measured clockwise from North. Combine this with Sine/Cosine rules to find distances between two ships or cities.
concepts.key_takeaway_zh: 在 HKDSE 中，方位角總是三位數字，從正北順時針測量。將此與正弦/餘弦公式結合，可求出兩艘船或城市之間的距離。

tips: Draw a North line at every point mentioned in the journey.
Use properties of parallel lines (alternate angles, interior angles) to relate bearings at different points.
tips_zh: 在旅程中提到的每一點都畫出一條正北線。
利用平行線性質（內錯角、同旁內角）來連結不同點的方位角。

common_traps.description: Measuring the angle in the wrong direction from North.
common_traps.description_zh: 從正北方向測量角度時方向錯誤。
common_traps.fix: Always turn your pencil CLOCKWISE from the North line.
common_traps.fix_zh: 始終從正北線 順時針 轉動你的鉛筆。

learning_modules.title: Elevation & Depression

concepts.name: Angles of Elevation and Depression
concepts.key_takeaway: Elevation is measured UP from the horizontal, Depression is measured DOWN. Due to parallel horizontal lines, the angle of elevation from A to B is equal to the angle of depression from B to A.
concepts.key_takeaway_zh: 仰角是從水平線向上測量，俯角是向下測量。由於水平線平行，從 A 到 B 的仰角等於從 B 到 A 的俯角。

tips: In depresson problems, remember the angle is between the horizontal and the line of sight, NOT the vertical wall and the line of sight.
For complex problems with two angles of elevation, you often need to set up two triangles and use simultaneous equations or express a common side in two ways.
tips_zh: 在俯角問題中，記住角度是在水平線與視線之間，而非垂直牆壁與視線之間。
對於具有兩個仰角的複雜問題，通常需要建立兩個三角形並使用聯立方程，或者用兩種方式表示一條公共邊。

common_traps.description: Placing the depression angle inside the triangle next to the vertical tower.
common_traps.description_zh: 將俯角標註在三角形內部、靠近垂直塔樓的地方。
common_traps.fix: Always draw a horizontal dashed line from the top point first to represent the 'level ground' perspective.
common_traps.fix_zh: 務必先從最高點畫一條水平虛線，以代表「平地」視角。
